manifest.name: sequence-enrollment
manifest.description: One person in one sequence with their own state (BO-F3-03): the enrolled subject, the recipient the steps send to, the next step to fire and when, and the lifecycle active -> paused -> active, active -> stopped-replied at the first recorded reply, active -> completed after the last step. A paused enrollment fires nothing; a stopped or completed one never fires again. (backlog:22bb154a72ea)

migrations.name: create_sequence_enrollments

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_sequence_enrollments
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."sequence_enrollments" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "sequence_source_key" TEXT,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "subject_resource" TEXT,
  "subject_id" TEXT,
  "subject_label" TEXT,
  "recipient" TEXT,
  "connection_key" TEXT,
  "vars" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'paused', 'stopped-replied', 'completed')),
  "current_step" BIGINT,
  "next_due_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "enrolled_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "actor_type" TEXT CHECK("actor_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "actor_id" TEXT,
  "source_package" TEXT,
  "source_action" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "sequence_enrollments_sequence_source_key"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_enrollments"("sequence_source_key");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_enrollments_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_enrollments"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_enrollments_subject_resource"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_enrollments"("subject_resource");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_enrollments_subject_id"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_enrollments"("subject_id");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_enrollments_connection_key"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_enrollments"("connection_key");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_enrollments_status"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_enrollments"("status");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_enrollments_next_due_at"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_enrollments"("next_due_at");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_enrollments_source_package"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_enrollments"("source_package");
